name: filter-bar
summary: Arranges host-admitted filter controls, actions, applied-filter content, and an optional result summary.

agent.useWhen: An app-owned search or result page needs a labelled presentation group around already-admitted controls and actions.
agent.avoidWhen: The component must own a GET form, query parameters, search state, command, route, applied-filter semantics, or JavaScript behavior.

invariants: The output is a div role=group, never a form; the host owns form/query binding and all operations.
Controls are required host-admitted markup; actions and applied content are optional host-admitted markup.
The optional result summary is nonblank escaped text announced with role=status.
AdmittedChildren is a host trust marker, not an HTML sanitizer.
The fragment contains exactly one [[attributes]], [[label]], [[summary]], [[controls]], [[actions]], and [[applied]] slot; expansion is exact and single-pass.
